method_notes: Worked from the 61 venues in concert-halls-theatres.json that had an empty calendar_sources array. For each I derived candidate What's On paths from the venue's official_url (plus targeted web searches where the guess failed) and fetched every candidate; nothing was recorded from an unfetched pattern, and redirects were followed to their real destination before being accepted. Sites whose listings are JavaScript-rendered or that reject plain HTTP fetches (Academy Music Group, LW Theatres, Royal Albert Hall, Southbank Centre, National Theatre, Swansea council venues, Portsmouth Guildhall, Brighton Centre, Blackpool Grand, Stockport Plaza, Bridlington Spa, Millennium Forum, The Lowry, Factory International) were re-fetched in a headless browser and only recorded once dated forthcoming events were actually visible. Five shared operator platforms were CONFIRMED by fetching each member venue individually: Academy Music Group at academymusicgroup.com/<venue-slug>/events (5 venues here - O2 Shepherd's Bush Empire, O2 Apollo Manchester, O2 City Hall Newcastle, O2 Guildhall Southampton, O2 Academy Glasgow - with the o2<venue>.co.uk domains 301-redirecting into it), LW Theatres at lwtheatres.co.uk/theatres/<slug>/whats-on/ (5 venues - Cambridge, Gillian Lynne, His Majesty's, London Palladium, Theatre Royal Drury Lane), Trafalgar Entertainment at trafalgartickets.com/<venue-slug>/en-GB (3 venues - Wycombe Swan, Southend/Cliffs Pavilion, New Theatre Cardiff - reached by 302 from the venue-branded domains), Nederlander UK at nederlander.co.uk/<theatre> (3 venues - Adelphi, Aldwych, Dominion, with a combined /whats-on/ listing), and the City and County of Swansea CMS serving Swansea Grand and Brangwyn Hall; BH Live (Bournemouth Pavilion, BIC) and Sheffield Theatres, Royal & Derngate, Ipswich Theatres, Anvil Arts, Winter Gardens Blackpool and SEC each publish one multi-venue, venue-tagged listing. 58 of the 61 venues got a confirmed calendar URL. Three were not recorded: Theatre Royal, Newcastle (theatreroyal.co.uk serves an expired TLS certificate - ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID - to both plain fetch and browser, so nothing could be verified), Leeds Town Hall (site is live but carries no programme at all; the venue is closed for refurbishment and directs enquiries elsewhere), and St David's Hall, Cardiff (stdavidshallcardiff.co.uk does not resolve - NXDOMAIN - and the hall is reported closed following the RAAC discovery). Shaftesbury Theatre's official /whats-on/ page is recorded but with events_currently_present false, because it lists the programme by title only and renders no dates on the listing page itself.
